story.text: I worked on the data pipeline that takes the sensor readings from the machines and cleans them up before they go into the warehouse. It was in Python, and we used Airflow to schedule it. The old one broke all the time, so I rewrote the parsing part and it got way more reliable. The analysts stopped pinging us every morning.
